title: Skyboy skill metadata
description: Machine-readable metadata for one skill folder under skills/<category>/<skill-name>/. The file must be named skill.json and live beside that folder's SKILL.md.

name.description: The skill's bare slug. Must equal the folder name under skills/<category>/.

category.description: Category derived from the folder path under skills/ (top-level folder, optionally subcategory). Must not be invented: it has to match the folder the skill lives in.

version.description: Semver. Bump on every content change; the catalog exporter hashes folder contents to detect drift.

description.description: The 160-char display line shown on cards and in search results. No marketing fluff.

command.description: The exact CLI invocation: 'skyboy add <name>' where <name> equals this file's name field. Cross-checked by validate-skill.go.

source_url.description: Upstream repo when the skill is forked or mirrored; null for originals.

compatible_agents.description: Agent slugs from the catalog's agents list (claude-code, cursor, gemini-cli, ...).

dependencies.description: Other skyboy skills this one requires, by id. Resolved transitively by 'skyboy add'.

last_verified.description: ISO date of the last agent-tested pass. Drives staleness flags; missing means never verified.

compatibility.description: Per-agent tested state. Keys are agent slugs (claude-code, cursor, ...); values are objects with an optional tool_surface string (e.g. mcp-2025-06; null/absent = untested) and optional notes string.

origin.description: Who published the skill: skyboy (official), vendor (vendor repo), or community (default).

verified.description: Review flag for community skills. Must be true for community skills seeking verified tier.
